in_sanskrit.name: प्रभव:
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who causes manifestation or emergence, the one who develops or grows.

in_marathi.name: Prabhav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabhav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prabhav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prabhava', which means radiant or shining. It is a powerful name that signifies the light and creativity within an individual.
